```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(factoextra)
library(ggplot2)
library(cluster)
```

## Optimal Number of Clusters: Gap Statistic

```{r gap-stat}
# Step 1: Prepare data properly
data <- USArrests
data <- na.omit(data)
data <- scale(data)
data <- as.data.frame(data)  # Ensure it's a data frame

# Step 2: Use gap_stat method (requires set.seed)
set.seed(123)
fviz_nbclust(data, kmeans, method = "gap_stat")
```
